conclusion: Portfolio optimizer eliminated all pairwise HLA-level competition (0.000 vs 0.066) by rejecting a redundant A*30:02 peptide in favor of a weaker but non-competing C*03:03 peptide. Sacrificed 18% of total presentation for 100% competition reduction.
caveat: Peptides KVDPIGHVY, KVDPIGHVYIF, and LMKVDPIGHVY are overlapping sequences from the same antigen. The current competition model captures HLA-level competition only. Same-antigen redundancy is a planned extension.
